summary: Owner order of 2026-09-26 (agent inference): the research agent gains an Anthropic Messages transport (anthropic.messages.v1) translating the loop's history into tool_use/tool_result blocks and back, registered as engy-anthropic (https://api.engy.ai) and anthropic (https://api.anthropic.com), plus engy-chat on the Chat Completions transport. Development-grant admission names these providers specifically (GRANT_PROVIDERS) and a grant's provider must equal the campaign's. Engy's model ladder is allowed with its published prices as a declared list basis, deepseek-v4-flash-0731 the default and deepseek-v4.1-flash refused. Each call is settled from Engy's x_engy.charged_micro, kept beside the token-price estimate; a missing report keeps the full reservation. The per-call journal records the charge, reasoning and cached tokens and x_engy request_id, miner and worker; each turn's cost is written beside the epoch, and the campaign status reports cost per turn and a caching check that flags CACHING_NOT_WORKING. Rate limits, 529 and overloaded responses are typed rate limits retried under new reservations. The key is read from its file only at dispatch; environment-variable credentials were removed. Fixture transports only; no live provider call was made.
